simple.meaning: בְּכִירָה (bᵉkîyrâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “the eldest daughter.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: בְּכִירָה (H1067) appears 6 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 19:31, with occurrences in Genesis, 1 Samuel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בְּכִירָה (H1067) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in בְּכִירָה (H1067) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: בְּכִירָה (bᵉkîyrâh) / H1067 is traced through Genesis 19:31, Genesis 19:33, Genesis 19:34, Genesis 19:37 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H1067. bekirah בְּכִירָה noun feminine first-born , always of women Gen 19:31 ; Genesis 9:33; 19:34 , 37 ; 29:26 (JE) 1Sam 14:49 .

occurrences.englishText: The firstborn said to the younger, “Our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in to us in the way of all the earth.
They made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father. He didn’t know when she lay down, nor when she arose.

It came to pass on the next day, that the firstborn said to the younger, “Behold, I lay last night with my father. Let’s make him drink wine again tonight. You go in, and lie with him, that we may preserve our father’s family line.”
The firstborn bore a son, and named him Moab. He is the father of the Moabites to this day.
Laban said, “It is not done so in our place, to give the younger before the firstborn.
Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan, Ishvi, and Malchishua; and the names of his two daughters were these: the name of the firstborn Merab, and the name of the younger Michal.
